video_title: Anthros Chair Review: The Actual Fix for Bad Posture?
evidence: Live Lean TV's July 31, 2026 English-language YouTube video states that Anthros partnered with the creator on the video and includes a creator-specific Anthros link. SponsorRadar independently identifies the same July 31 video as sponsored by Anthros. Anthros sells a tangible ergonomic office chair. Anthros' official 2026 Team Anthros affiliate page explicitly recruits health/wellness creators, desk workers, podcasters and other creators and instructs applicants to email affiliates@anthros.com.
